SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. C. REGISTRY
No. S. B. 11 / Station
Date November __, 1933.

Subject Establishment of branches of Japanese department stores.

Made by ____________________ Forwarded by ____________________

With reference to the attached extract from the
"Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury" dated November 16, 1933,
regarding the opening of branches by Japanese department
stores in different cities in Central China, I have to state
that the "Daimaru Department Store", with a head office in
Osaka, took over the "Minoya", a Japanese mat shop at No.
201 Soone Road, together with its factories in Soochow and
at Baikal Road, Shanghai, prior to the outbreak of the Sino-
Japanese hostilities. Since the transfer this concern
has been operating a small shop at the address on Soone Road,
dealing in matting, building materials, bicycles, auto-
tricycles etc..

The "Shirokiya Department Store" with a head office
in Tokyo, is stated to have recently obtained a large part
of the shares of the "Nippon Commercial Union", No. 446
Nanking Road, and so succeeded in obtaining control of this
enterprise. Business in Central China will be transacted
by the "Shirokiya Department Store" through the "Nippon
Commercial Union" and a branch will be opened in Hangchow.

The "Takashimaya Department Store" in Kyoto has
established a branch of its business at No. 56 North
Szechuen Road and another branch will be opened in Nanking.

The "Okamasa Department Store" of Nagasaki opened a
branch office in the Yokohama Specie Bank Building, the Bund,
at the beginning of this year and opened a general goods
store in the Dixwell Apartments, North Szechuen Road towards
the end of May, this year.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 21-NOV.1933）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. C. 登记处
编号 S. B. 11 / 警署
日期 1933年11月__日。

主题 日本百货公司设立分店事宜。

编制人 ___ 转呈人 ___

兹就附上的1933年11月16日《上海晚邮报及信使报》（Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury）摘录，关于日本百货公司在华中各城市开设分店一事，本人谨陈述如下：“大丸百货公司”（Daimaru Department Store），总行设于大阪，在中日敌对行动爆发前，已接管位于苏州路201号的日本草席店“美乃屋”（Minoya），以及其在苏州和上海百老汇路（Baikal Road）的工厂。自移交以来，该商号一直在苏州路上述地址经营一家小店，经销草席、建筑材料、自行车、机动三轮车等商品。

据称，总行设于东京的“白木屋百货公司”（Shirokiya Department Store）最近获得了南京路446号“日本商业联合会”（Nippon Commercial Union）的大部分股份，从而成功取得对该企业的控制权。在华中的业务将由“白木屋百货公司”通过“日本商业联合会”进行，并将在杭州开设一家分店。

京都的“高岛屋百货公司”（Takashimaya Department Store）已在北四川路56号设立了其业务分店，另一家分店将在南京开设。

长崎的“冈正百货公司”（Okamasa Department Store）于今年年初在外滩横滨正金银行大楼开设了办事处，并于今年5月底在北四川路的狄思威公寓（Dixwell Apartments）开设了一家百货商店。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1933年11月21日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ________
S.S.C, Special Branch. Station 8/5/
REPORT Date May 20, 1938. 23 5 38

SECRET

Subject Japanese "Piracy" of Foreign Trade Marks.

Made by ________ and Forwarded by Inspector Papp.

Further enquiries indicate that the endeavours
of certain Japanese merchants to flood the market with
imitation "Foreign goods" have so far met with but little
success. Despite this initial setback, one of the Japanese
merchants expressed confidence in the scheme and stated
that imitations of almost any foreign goods are already
obtainable in Shanghai at short notice. In this connection,
it is learned that a special contraband organ has been
established somewhere in Hongkew recently with expert packers
working to imitate popular brands. They are said to be
using wrapping papers bearing trade-mark signs of foreign
firms, which have been specially prepared in Tokyo by
highly competent artists and printers. It is reported that
a large number of various imported goods have already been
imitated. According to one source the number of imitations
is set at some 170 or more, including canned foods, candies,
electric apparatus, hardwares, piece goods, grass-wares,
milk products, rubber goods etc. By outward appearance
these imitations are said to be excellent and in the case of
several classes of goods the contents too do not fall much
off the mark, still in most cases the contents are but cheap
imitations.

These contraband goods are expected to find shortly
their way into grocery stores, department stores, electric
shops, restaurants and various other kinds of shops because
of the good commissions paid to their sale-agents.

（左侧批注：D.C.(G) D.C.(6w)）
（左侧印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 20 MAY 1938 m.b.）

档案编号 ________
S.S.C, 特科。 警署 8/5/
报告 日期 1938年5月20日。 23 5 38

机密

主题 日本对外国商标的“盗版”行为。

编制人 ________ 并由 Papp 巡官转呈。

进一步调查显示，某些日本商人试图以仿冒“洋货”充斥市场的努力迄今收效甚微。尽管初期受挫，其中一名日本商人对这一计划表示信心，并称几乎任何外国商品的仿制品在上海均可在短时间内获得。就此获悉，最近虹口某处已成立一个专门的走私机构，配有专业包装人员，致力于模仿流行品牌。据说他们使用印有外国商行商标标志的包装纸，这些包装纸由东京技艺高超的艺术家和印刷商专门制作。据报道，大量各类进口商品已被仿制。据一方消息来源称，仿制品数量达170种或更多，包括罐头食品、糖果、电器、五金、匹头、草制品、乳制品、橡胶制品等。从外观上看，这些仿制品据说非常精良，且在几类商品中，其内容物也与正品相差不大，但在大多数情况下，内容物仅为廉价仿品。

由于支付给销售代理人的佣金丰厚，预计这些走私货物很快就会进入杂货店、百货公司、电器店、餐馆和各种其他类型的商店。

（左侧批注：D.C.(G) D.C.(6w)）
（左侧印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特科 1938年5月20日 m.b.）

（签名）
D.C. （特科）。

E. Papp
巡官

Subject Japanese "Piracy" of Foreign Trade Marks.

Made by/ ____ and ____ Forwarded by ____ Inspector Papp.

It has been learned that several Japanese
business concerns are contemplating to glut the local
market with imitation "foreign goods" of well known foreign
brands by applying identical packing and using identical
trade marks or labels as are on the original goods.

This piracy of foreign trade marks will be applied
to foreign goods of all descriptions, which have here a
good market, including "Carnation" milk, "Nestles" chocolates,
"Gilette" blades, "Arrow" shirts, etc. etc. Such imitation
goods will be sold at greatly reduced prices; the reductions
will range between 50 and 60 percent below the price of
the original articles. The method of sale will be similar
to that which had been adopted in Manchukuo and subsequently
in North China ports.

According to information there are already large
stocks of imitation goods at Hongkew. Whenever practicable,
Japanese goods intended for sale in Shanghai will be brought
here in bulk while the packing and labelling will be performed
locally.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH - 5 MAY 1938）

REPORT
Date October 25, 37.
Subject Alleged dumping of Japanese goods on the local market under the guise of goods of Italian origin.
Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang. Forwarded by C Crawford

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce issued a confidential circular on October 22 to its members informing them of the receipt of a despatch from the Soong Wu Martial Law Commanders Headquarters giving the following information :-

"On representations made by the Mitsui Bussan Kaisha, Mitsubishi Shoji Kaisha, the Yokohama Specie Bank and the South Manchuria Railway Company, Mr. Okamoto, a member of the Japanese Consulate-General has arranged with the local Italian Consular Authorities for the dumping of Japanese goods on the local market under the guise of goods of Italian origin. It is reported that a foreigner named 'Macay' has been appointed to assist in the carrying out of this scheme and an office will be established in the vicinity of the General Office of the Ford Hire Service, Great Western Road near Bubbling Well Road. This person will be responsible for the sale of those Japanese goods, the transportation of which will be undertaken by the 'Italian' (?) Company of the Shanghai Volunteer Corps.

"Four Chinese named Wong Lih-tsing (王立青), Tsui Tsung Sung (朱振声), Tai Boo Tseng (戴步政) and Kuh Ngo Liang (葛良玉) are assisting in this movement."

In conclusion, the circular of the Chamber of Commerce urges its members to guard against having any transaction with persons connected with this movement.

Sih Tse liang
C. D. I.
